name: Candice Renoir
description:
Candice Renoir had put her career on standby for 10 years. When she  returns from Singapore to resume service in a port town in the south of  France, she feels a bit “rusty”. Despite the obvious defiance of her  unit and a cynical superior who doesn’t make her job any easier, she is  determined to turn her so-called weaknesses into strengths, solving the  most complex cases with her common sense, her acute observation and her  practical nature seasoned by a busy daily routine.

Only Candice can  catch a killer because she knows the chemical composition of a  window-cleaning product or determine the hour of a murder from the  cooking-time of kebabs… Candice is only naive on the outside, and nobody  can resist her!

videos.title: Corsica
videos.overview: Following their non-proposal, Candice and Antoine go on a honeymoon in Corsica. They spent their savings on a dream stay in a luxurious hotel on a beach with turquoise waters. During dinner, a man notices Candice in her pretty flowered dress and her bright laugh – but perhaps the attention is a little too much? Antoine gets into a fight with a man he thinks is a flirt, and the couple spends the night apart, deciding to go home. But the next day, the pseudo flirt is found dead in the trunk of the car.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: Now a financial investigator, Candice is bored out of her mind. With Halloween approaching, she accompanies Antoine to pick pumpkins on a farm with his daughter, Suzanne. Attracted by a marmalade shop run by a witch, Candice forgets to watch over Suzanne and, a few seconds later, the child is kidnapped by Jack O' Lantern, the scarecrow from the field. There are numerous tracks but Candice, frustrated to no longer be a field investigator, can only act in secret.

videos.title: Still Waters Run Deep
videos.overview: After a 10-year sabbatical in Singapore, Candice Renoir is back in the south of France and back to work as a police commandant. As she deals with divorce proceedings, four children and skeptical colleagues, her first murder case isnt an easy task. On the seashore a seemingly unremarkable woman is found dead, and only Candice is able to guess the victim's double life.

videos.title: The More, the Merrier?
videos.overview: Candice's children are having trouble adjusting to their new life and Candice's team are having trouble adjusting to their new boss. There are still crimes to be solved and Candice and her friend Pascale, the forensic pathologist, are called to the scene when a man is found dead lying next to his barbecue.

videos.title: Eat and Drink, for Tomorrow We Shall Die!
videos.overview: When 17-year-old Arthur is thrown into the harbor, Candice learns he was binge drinking, an activity she"s never heard of. The young man survives but the case strikes close to home for Candice, as she's having problems with her own teenager, Emma. In the end, it's these very difficulties as a mother that help her crack Arthur"s case.

videos.title: Credit Where Credit"s Due
videos.overview: Having only had one lover in her life—her ex-husband—Candice is hesitant to go to bed with her handsome neighbor, Hervé. Soon enough she's distracted from her dilemma by a new case, when a badly damaged body is found in a dump. Candice recognizes the victim as an occasional prostitute and she deploys her unique assets to gain access to a "special" party.

videos.title: To Con a Con Man
videos.overview: One night, Candice is called to an emergency at a local hotel after a wheelchair-bound man is thrown down a flight of stairs. It turns out the man had leukemia and had been tended to by the hotel staff but lately his condition had worsened. Was it attempted murder, or suicide?  Candice feels exhausted from the demands of work and motherhood when someone appears out of the blue to make it all worse.

videos.title: Never a Borrower nor a Lender Be
videos.overview: The kids are happy to have their father, Laurent, back home but Candice is far from thrilled. Meanwhile, she has work to do, as a woman in her 40s is found dead in her car. Candice notes the scent of a plant-based poison and learns the woman was an aficionada of natural medicines. As she calls upon her knowledge of herbal remedies to help solve the case, she also learns Laurent"s true intentions.

videos.title: Death of the Sinner
videos.overview: When teenager Dylan Rieux is found murdered in a field with cannabis in his pocket, for Antoine it's a drug crime but for Candice it's a love story gone wrong. The victim was in love with a girl named Juliette, who left him to join an evangelical group. Candice sets out to locate the religious community and cast light on Dylan's death.

videos.title: The End Justifies the Means
videos.overview: When Antoine is temporarily assigned to a different police division, Candice is on her own to solve the case of Sabine Missoni, a naval architect murdered on her work site. With other team members also unavailable, Candice is coming up short until her twin boys unexpectedly provide a clue. Meanwhile, Laurent makes a decision that could impact Candice's relationship with Hervé.

videos.title: Out of the Mouths of Babes
videos.overview: Candice investigates an assault on a rugby coach left for dead. The case first turns to a fired ex-player but then Candice discovers the victim had a long-held secret.

videos.title: (Don’t Bite Off) More Than You Can Chew
videos.overview: Submerged in the middle of an oyster bed lies the body of a university student. Candice thinks his death might have to do with the poaching and illegal sale of oysters.

videos.title: The Heart Has Its Reasons
videos.overview: When a strange email is sent to the station predicting a man’s death, Candice tracks down the victim, only for him to die of a heart attack at the foretold time.

videos.title: Ill-Gotten Gains Seldom Prosper
videos.overview: When a brilliant young businessman is thrown off a bridge, Candice suspects the murderer of being a graffiti artist and must hunt down the city’s most infamous tagger.

videos.title: A Dog-Eat-Dog World
videos.overview: When teenager Alice reports that her veterinarian mother has gone missing, Candice is the only one at the station who takes the girl seriously.

videos.title: Out of the Habit
videos.overview: When the body of a naked woman is found in a nature reserve, markings on her knees make Candice suspect she was a Carmelite nun, and she visits the convent for answers.

videos.title: Beauty Is Only Skin Deep
videos.overview: When a beautiful woman washes up on a beach, clues point Candice to a nearby campsite that’s also being watched by the Crime Squad, tracking a bank robber on the run.

videos.title: The Rose Hides Its Thorns
videos.overview: A worker for the famous French perfume manufacturer Lacombe is found dead, having been sprayed with a deadly poison. Candice investigates possible industrial espionage.

videos.title: Silence Is Golden
videos.overview: A boat catches fire with a recently retired soldier on board. He had been struggling with civilian life and Candice discovers he was surveilling his own house. But why?

videos.title: Silence Means Consent
videos.overview: Young actress Amira is murdered at the Sète Theater. Candice is convinced the killer is a fellow troupe member but the girl may have been leading a double life.

videos.title: Too Much Is Better Than Not Enough
videos.overview: A young man who was supposed to be working abroad is poisoned with strychnine. Why was he still in town? And why did he lie to his family?

videos.title: Tough Love
videos.overview: When a woman is found stabbed to death in her home, suspicion falls on her lover, a killer who has just been released from prison. However, Candice has her doubts.

videos.title: Of Penitence and Punishment
videos.overview: An anonymous phone tip sends Candice and her team to a local pond in search of a murder victim. Despite blood at the scene, there’s no body to be found.

videos.title: Dead Men Tell No Tales
videos.overview: The murder of a bus driver in a vacant lot looks like a robbery gone wrong. Things get less clear when two suspects claim the man paid them to stage a fake attack.

videos.title: Two Peas in a Pod
videos.overview: The body of a young mother turns up in a fishing net. Mango-flavored candy lying on the ground nearby puts Candice on the murderer’s trail.

videos.title: Don’t Wash Your Dirty Laundry in Public
videos.overview: Disaster looms when her boss takes maternity leave and Candice must step in as station commander. Why is Candice’s second-in-command also taking time off?

videos.title: Charity Begins at Home
videos.overview: An investigation begins when an unmanned sailboat washes up on the shore. Candice displays her flirtatious side.

videos.title: Blind Rage
videos.overview: A new addition joins the team and seems to be just as “unorthodox” as Candice. Meanwhile, things come to a head between the two men in the commandant’s life.

videos.title: To Each His Own Pain
videos.overview: One of Candice’s officers becomes the main suspect after her ex mysteriously disappears. Candice is determined to prove her colleague is innocent.

videos.title: Appearances Can Be Deceiving
videos.overview: A badly torn-up body is discovered in a dance hall. The team begin to unravel an incredibly violent family tragedy.

videos.title: Any Betrayal Can Be Forgiven (Baudelaire)
videos.overview: Things are looking up for Candice and the family after they move to a new house on the coast. At work, a former colleague with a grudge is proving a thorn in her side.

videos.title: Doubt Is a Tribute to Truth
videos.overview: Candice gets rattled by a defense attorney while testifying in court against a serial rapist. Antoine’s unit continues to interfere in her investigations.

videos.title: Man Is His Own Worst Enemy
videos.overview: While driving her kids to the movies, Candice pulls over to rescue an elderly man being harassed by a young woman. Is there’s more to the incident than meets the eye?

videos.title: An Ounce of Prevention Is Worth a Pound of Cure
videos.overview: Her children and colleagues are worried about Candice, who is not her usual self after suffering a series of setbacks. Will a new murder case get her on track again?

videos.title: Out of Sight, Out of Mind
videos.overview: Antoine is happy to be back working with his old team.  A serial killer case takes Candice to her hometown and memories of a traumatic time in her life.

videos.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
videos.overview: After her main suspect is murdered, Candice comes under direct threat, too. What does she have to hide and why is she not leveling with her local counterpart?

videos.title: Some Things Are Better Left Unsaid
videos.overview: Candice and Antoine investigate the death of a young woman hit by a car. The lies and alibis in the case echo those in the detectives’ private lives.

videos.title: Where There’s Smoke, There’s Fire
videos.overview: News of a child abduction whips the town into a frenzy. Candice and the team have 24 hours to solve what turns out to be an increasingly complex case.

videos.title: A Friend in Need Is a Friend Indeed
videos.overview: After a dead body turns up in the trunk of an abandoned car, Candice learns that a crucial piece of evidence is missing.  Antoine has a decision to make - or does he?

videos.title: An Eye for an Eye Makes the Whole World Blind (Gandhi)
videos.overview: A death threat against one of Candice’s team may be related to an old case.  Two developments risk leaving the inspector all alone.

videos.title: A fault confessed is half forgiven
videos.overview: Candice and the team are called to a "murder party," where they have a hard time convincing the participants that one of them really has been killed.

videos.title: Birds of a feather flock together
videos.overview: Recovering from an injury, Candice finds herself confined to a wheelchair and wearing a neck brace but that doesn't stop her from going undercover to crack a case.

videos.title: Youth must pass
videos.overview: Candice looks for a link between a shooting at a street café and some erotic photos posted on the internet. Meanwhile, her chemistry with Antoine begins to heat up.

videos.title: Money has no smell
videos.overview: The murder of a court clerk takes the team into the shadowy world of conservatorship, with Candice posing as an "adult under guardianship" to get to the truth.

videos.title: Desperate times call for desperate measures
videos.overview: Candice investigates when the owner of a riding school that offers equine therapy is shot dead with a hunting rifle. The detective gets a little therapy herself.

videos.title: Better late than never
videos.overview: After the team are called to a villa whose owner has been tasered, they find an unexpected guest on the premises and end up on the trail of a serial killer.

videos.title: Curiosity is a bad habit
videos.overview: Could a whistleblower, a body partially eaten by eels and a family destroyed by a health scandal somehow all be tied together? Candice and her team try to find a link.

videos.title: At night, all cats are grey
videos.overview: The team infiltrate the dating site used by their latest victim, who was killed in her home just ahead of a romantic liaison. Candice looks for a little love of her own.

videos.title: What a woman wants... (Part 1)
videos.overview: A woman is murdered the same way her prostitute mother had been killed back in 1975. During the case, Candice suffers an accident at home and falls into a coma.

videos.title: What a woman wants... (Part 2)
videos.overview: Candice"s coma takes her back to 1975, where she investigates the murder that happened that year. She manages to solve it but can she now manage to wake up?

videos.title: Beauty Is Pain
videos.overview: Candice has decided to turn down her transfer and is back on friendly terms with her boss - at least she thinks so. Everything seems to be going great, but when Antoine returns, where will he be assigned and how will he fit into Candice's life?

videos.title: Revenge Is a Dish Best Served Cold
videos.overview: A surprising crime scene awaits Inspector Renoir and her unit when a young woman is discovered with her head bashed in under the skeleton of a T-Rex. Meanwhile, at loggerheads with Antoine, Candice gets revenge by getting herself a new captain.

videos.title: He Who Laughs Last Laughs Longest
videos.overview: The murder of 60-year-old Pierre Rossi - who was recently involved with a young, cheerful, and beautiful blonde named "Candice Renoir", rattles the unit. Candice faces the prospect that someone may have stolen her identity to commit the crime.

videos.title: Ask No Questions and Hear No Lies
videos.overview: The body of a handsome young African man is found tied up and drowned. Visiting his widow, Candice starts poking around in the world of female sex tourism. Meanwhile, an overwhelmed Antoine has to bring his 18-month-old daughter to work with him.

videos.title: A Dog Is a Man's Best Friend
videos.overview: A jogger finds the body of a young woman on a trail with a purebred dog standing guard over her. Discovering that the victim and her dog were a winning duo that participated in agility competitions, Candice and her dog join the victim's kennel club.

videos.title: The Straw that Broke the Camel's Back
videos.overview: A mother driven to extremes by the constant bullying of her child takes Candice and her son, Leo, hostage at his school. The nightmare worsens when Candice runs into the German teacher, who happens to be an old boyfriend holding a grudge.

videos.title: The Road to Hell Is Paved in Good Intentions
videos.overview: A tragic death shocks Candice's unit especially Antoine, who thought he'd lost Candice as well. Paul Périer, the in-house shrink, decides group therapy would be good for them. A nice plan... that gets derailed when they see a murder unfold live.

videos.title: All's Fair in Love and War
videos.overview: An 18-year-old Swiss national's body is found dead with clear signs of a struggle and a Foreign Legion card on his body. Antoine infiltrates the Foreign Legion regiment, where he discovers dark passions lurking among the service members.

videos.title: There's Strength in Numbers, Part 1
videos.overview: After the troubling disappearance of an entire family, luminol dusting reveals large traces of blood, which DNA testing links to each family member. Was it a quadruple murder, or is there another, less dire, explanation?

videos.title: There's Strength in Numbers, Part 2
videos.overview: Candice tries to understand the causes of the sudden disappearance of a family.

videos.title: Forewarned Is Forearmed
videos.overview: When Candice cuts her honeymoon short and rushes to Antoine's side in the hospital, Max is left feeling uneasy about his marriage's future.  Meanwhile, a new case emerges after a park worker excavating an uprooted tree unearths a dead body too.

videos.title: Where There Is Life, There Is Hope
videos.overview: When Sébastien Da Fonseca, a star on the local water tournament scene, turns up dead, nautical rivalries, doping scandals, secret children and infertility all appear to be viable motives. Which one sparked the murder?

videos.title: To Errr Is Human
videos.overview: The team investigates a crime scene out on the open sea when two bodies with gunshot wounds are discovered aboard a sailboat. Meanwhile, Candice finds that emotions are running high at home as well as among the staff at the station.

videos.title: A Light Purse Is a Heavy Curse
videos.overview: Enjoying herself at the market with some time away from the family, Candice comes across a crowd of bystanders surrounding a dead homeless man. When troubling messages and other attacks on homeless people occur, fears of a 'purge' begin to take hold.

videos.title: Better Safe Than Sorry
videos.overview: After a routine doctor visit reveals that a young woman is pregnant, she reports a rape to the police, as she hadn't had sex in months. Presuming someone took advantage of her without her knowledge, Candice devises a plan to find the perpetrator.

videos.title: For Better or Worse, True Colors Shine Through
videos.overview: When the body of a young woman is found in the woods laid out in a precise manner, Candice recognizes the signature of the killer: Simon Belau, a man she arrested 20 years ago. She heads to Paris to find out whether he has murdered again.

videos.title: What a Fickle and Shifty Thing Is Woman
videos.overview: When Olivier Montfort is electrocuted in his jacuzzi, Candice faces off against a formidable killer, but it's hard to determine which of the two suspects is more Machiavellian in what proves to be a very twisted case.

videos.title: It's All Good Fun Until Someone Gets Hurt
videos.overview: After a young female boxer named Angélique vanishes, Candice and her unit investigate what she was doing right up until she disappeared. The team must move fast, as the first 48 hours are vital if they are to have any chance of finding her alive.

videos.title: Blood Tells No Lies
videos.overview: When a set designer on a TV show is found murdered, the team is called in to investigate but has trouble working the case. That is, until Candice recognizes the significance of a stone missing from one of the show's signature props.

videos.title: Great Minds Think Alike
videos.overview: With Antoine in need of an urgent operation, Candice replaces him on a delicate investigation involving the murder of a key figure in town, whose death was staged to look like a suicide. It's a high-stakes case with even higher risk.

videos.title: Don't Let the Cat Out of the Bag
videos.overview: A woman's body is found in her home with her head bashed in, her purse gone, and other signs of a break-in. After learning there had been a dispute over the house, Candice realizes the victim may not be who she thought.

videos.title: Fire Often Slumbers Beneath the Ashes
videos.overview: A body is spotted beneath a bridge, sparking a tense investigation involving victims of a nightclub fire. Meanwhile, Candice and Antoine deal with the fallout of his memory loss on their romantic relationships and new member Ismael joins the team.

videos.title: Plenty Is No Plague
videos.overview: Candice finds out Antoine has been investigating the disappearance of a childhood friend who has not been seen for three days. As the team looks into the trafficking of electronic waste, they end up face-to-face with the missing man's "patients."

videos.title: What Doesn't Kill You Makes You Stronger
videos.overview: A paraplegic man is found dead in bed, his legs covered in puncture marks. Was he killed by his wife, her lover, or his sex aide? Whoever did it, the motive seems to be jealousy - an emotion Candice is also struggling with in her feelings for Antoine.

videos.title: Good Things Come to Those Who Wait
videos.overview: The team seeks answers among the local immigrant community after a young man is strangled to death. As Candice makes an effort to move on from Antoine, she finds things heating up with a charming fireman.

videos.title: Let the Chips Fall Where They May
videos.overview: When a video-games fanatic is killed in his bedroom while his mother is home, she becomes the prime suspect. Antoine gets himself into a mess and needs Candice to get him out of it.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather Flock Together: Part 1
videos.overview: As the entire unit attends a day of training on "procedural portfolio management," Candice has to leave after she gets a text message from her daughter asking for her help. Concern for their boss mounts when she fails to return.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather Flock Together: Part 2
videos.overview: While Candice is being held hostage along with a kidnapped 10-year-old, the team works day and night to get to the bottom of her strange disappearance and find her.

videos.title: As You Sow, So You Shall Reap
videos.overview: The unit are called to an aviation school when one of the instructors turns up dead inside a mock-up of a Boeing 747. Antoine's memory begins to return but Candice continues to deal with the trauma of her abduction.

videos.title: As You Make Your Bed, So You Must Lie On It
videos.overview: The mood darkens at the station house as two Internal Affairs officers start snooping around, trying to investigate Candice. The team unites behind her and she and Antoine grow closer than ever.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Although she's placed on admin duty for hiding Antoine's amnesia, Candice can't help but get involved when a harassment victim goes missing and then turns up dead.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: With Candice still confined to administrative work, Antoine sends Val to the scene of a fatal car crash. She notices an empty cache box typically used to store drugs and suspects the crash was no accident.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In a protest against capital punishment, students dangle four fake hooded corpses from the roof of their exclusive prep school. The scene turns tragic when Antoine realizes one of the corpses is all too real.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Candice receives a call from a man who claims he is in mortal danger and says he possesses documents that incriminate a pharmaceutical company in causing leukemia. When he is murdered while on the line, Candice is left with only the call for clues.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The detectives are called to an alley where a psychiatrist has been murdered. As they dig into the case, a curious link emerges to sexual reorientation workshops.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A cosmetic surgeon's body is found in a villa pool with her face slashed and then a man with a bandaged face is found in the bathroom. Candice tries to unravel a mystery that may come down to whether the surgery was cosmetic or reconstructive.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The president of a hunting association is found dead in a wild boar enclosure, his body partly devoured. Solving the case just might help Candice regain favor in the office.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Candice has the opportunity to solve a locked-room mystery like Agatha Christie when the investigators and suspects are sequestered in the victim's possibly haunted mansion.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: When a bloodied medical student arrives at the station after suffering an assault, it becomes clear she's a victim of cyber harassment. Candice tracks a man who exploits his followers and assigns targets to attack.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: A dead body is found at a cabaret show that Candice had attended the night before. The news leaves her with a bad feeling about just what awaits her at the crime scene. A bomb threat suspends activity at the BSU.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: While sedated after being shot, Candice is torn between life and death. Unexpectedly, this ends up having repercussions on the resolution of a case.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Candice, released from the hospital, is recovering. She overplays her sickness in order to be served like a princess by her children.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The body of Mélanie Meyrieux is discovered lying below a quarry and it is not an accident. A report is made with the moving and storage company that she managed with her husband and her brother-in-law.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Zoé Sénéchal, 15, has just run away again and this time it has been more than a week since she left.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Four women put up anti-feminicide posters; however, a car comes up, drives up the sidewalk and smashes into the group. One of the four women is hit and falls back on the asphalt seriously injured.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The team frames a drug dealer for murder. Candice and Antoine question him for hours. The news of Commander Renoir's departure for Montpellier has spread and everyone wants to attend.
